en.topic_title: Gov’t refusal to release banned book list following independent bookstore arrests is ‘abuse of power,’ Christian NGO says
en.topic_summary:
The Hong Kong government’s refusal to release a list of banned books amounts to an “abuse of power” and undermines the rule of law, a conservative Christian NGO has said after authorities raided independent bookstores and arrested their staff last month.



Greenfield Bookstore in Mong Kok on July 30, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
